he.text: אִם־עֲוֹנֵינוּ עָנוּ בָנוּ יְיָ עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃ אִם־עֲוֹנוֹת תִּשְׁמָר־יָהּ אֲדֹנָי מִי־יַעֲמֹד׃ כִּי עִם יְיָ הַחֶסֶד וְהַרְבֵּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת׃ כִּי־עִמְּךָ הַסְּלִיחָה לְמַעַן תִּוָּרֵא׃ רְאֵה עָנְיֵנוּ וַעֲמָלֵנוּ וְשָׂא לְכָל־חַטֹּאותֵינוּ׃

en.text: Though our iniquities testify against us, O Lord, yet act kindly for the sake of thy name. O God! if thou wilt mark our iniquities: who is it, O Lord, that can stand? For with the Lord there is mercy, and with him there is abundant redemption. For with thee is pardon, therefore shalt thou be revered. Look upon our affliction and our pain, and forgive all our sins.
